integrity: Proof and executable finite-check script included; all infinite asymptotics proved analytically. Does not claim independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Two distinguishable free walkers on an infinite homogeneous chain, both reset to pure origin at common or independent Poisson times; entropy contrast is order-two and does not quantify entanglement. Unstudied interactions, fermionic/bosonic symmetrization and finite lattice effects. Literature priority not independently certified.
title: Shared Poisson resets produce an unbounded Rényi-two correlation signature in free quantum walks
